text:
Emma Chen: Quick heads-up — we're opening an early preview of Dedicated RTX 8000 pools in eu-central-1 next Tue (2026-03-31).
Emma Chen: TL;DR: small preview capacity for canary customers, hourly billing during preview, no SLA yet, reservation form for access. https://redwood.example/rtx8000-preview
Emma Chen: Key details:
- preview footprint: initial pools spread across 2 AZs in eu-central-1
- per-org cap: 1 pool (up to 8 GPUs) during preview; exceptions via form
- reservation type: `preview-reserve` (30d rolling window)
- perf note: ~1.8x cost-efficiency vs our A40 baseline for 2k-seq workloads in our runner (depends on model/seq)
- SLA: none for preview; production SLA planned after validation
Emma Chen: @eng-sre please monitor latency, temperature, and kernel errors during the canary window.
Raj Patel: Awesome. Any per-customer throttles or burst rules?
Emma Chen: Per-customer max: 8 GPUs. Burst will be allowed within the pool but governed by autoscale policies.
Linda Gomez: Billing cadence for preview — hourly or committed? Customers need clarity.
Emma Chen: Hourly for preview, committed/reserved pricing to be introduced post-preview.
Mauro Silva: Ran quick internal perf runs vs h100: for 512 tokens we saw ~12% lower p50 latency in our runner on RTX8000 for open models. I'll upload the raw numbers to the console tomorrow.
infra-bot: [system] Reservation quota updated for eu-central-1: +rtx8000-preview (org cap = 8 GPUs).
deploy-bot: [system] Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC -> rtx8000-canary pools will receive a subset of new dedicated traffic.
Raj Patel: If capacity is tight during preview can we fallback automatically to h100/h200?
Emma Chen: Yes — default routing will fallback to nearest compatible hardware. Example preference config: `preferred_hardware: [\"rtx8000\", \"h100\"]`.
Emma Chen: Sample configuration for Dedicated pools:
```
model: redwood/llama-3-70b
hardware_preference: [\"rtx8000\",\"h100\"]
autoscale: {min:1, max:4}
```
Raj Patel: Any special driver/kernel versions to note?
Mauro Silva: RTX8000 testing used NVIDIA 525.* driver stack in our image. No driver regressions observed so far; we'll push updated images to canary tomorrow.
Linda Gomez: @sales please flag hourly-preview billing in the customer comms.
Emma Chen: If you want to grant a customer preview access, add them via the form and tag me. We'll evaluate exceptions case-by-case.
Mauro Silva: I'll attach the perf CSV and the thermal traces to the console once they're uploaded.
Emma Chen: Thanks team — please keep an eye on infra metrics during the rollout window. Ping me for any anomalies. :party:
Emma Chen: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rtx8000-preview
Linda Gomez: Nice work — excited to see this ship. :thumbsup:
